observations.statement: An identical five-clause bridge with two fresh variables connects the two H121 primal components while remaining satisfiable for every assignment of its original endpoints.

Placing the bridge outside every charge-visible radius separates bridge neighborhoods from charge neighborhoods, reducing exact local equality of the connected pair to H121 base equality plus one identical bridge feature.
The connected H125 primal graph retains treewidth at least m-1 because it contains an original toroidal Tseitin primal component as a subgraph.
Every finite positive list of m distinct satisfiable L-bit encodings has a globally SAT-sound exact-membership circuit of size at most 3mL.
An H124 list hitting all L^k-size SAT-sound circuits must contain more than L^(k-1)/3 distinct formulas, regardless of witness diversity.

After connectedness is removed as an input side channel, the restricted locality route still depends on one unproved global theorem: every legal low-treewidth output must factor through a parity-insensitive common quotient.
C019 creates no terminal shadow: all three descendants survive their registered attacks, while H127 remains explicitly open and H124 remains weakened rather than refuted.
After C019 the expected inventory is 110 live hypotheses and 17 terminal historical nodes; these counts are bookkeeping rather than a completion percentage.
